name: Ondara (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with a white castle with three towers, the figure of the municipal arms of Ondara.
history: The flag was approved on 7 October 1994 and published in the DOGV no. 2402 of 7 December 1994, described as a flag of proportions 2:3 with, on a blue field, a silver castle with three towers; the castle alludes to the old fortress of which only the Torre del Rellotge remains.
